messages:
ben-engineering: Heads-up — planning to split my time 3 days/week SF office, 2 days/week Vancouver starting June 1. What's the process for homebase change, WFH stipend proration, and any tax/payroll steps? cc @alex-peopleops

alex-peopleops: Thanks Ben — quick Q: is this permanent or a 3-month pilot? We have different tax nexus rules for recurring work in another country.

ben-engineering: Likely long-term, will keep CA as primary but want Vancouver as a recurring remote pattern. Not relocating, just commuting + remote.

samira-payroll: Thanks for flagging. If you work regularly from Canada we'll need to update payroll and tax forms. Can you confirm expected days/month in CA vs BC? Also need SIN for payroll cross-check (if you'll be paid in CAD).

ben-engineering: Expect ~8 days/month in Vancouver. I have a PR passport and can work legally, no VISA needed. Not changing bank info yet — prefer USD direct deposit.

payroll-bot: Automated checklist:
1) People Ops intake form: https://redwood.company/forms/homebase-change
2) Payroll needs: updated W-4/W-9, provincial tax forms, SIN verification if CAD pay required
3) Benefits: provincial health premiums may apply — benefits team will review
4) Stipend proration: stipend is prorated by full calendar months for mid-month changes
5) Escalation: if recurring days >60/year we trigger legal review for tax nexus

alex-peopleops: We'll submit to payroll once you fill the intake form. On stipend: we prorate monthly and use the last payroll simulation to compute net impact. For cross-border commuting months we typically cap stipend at 50% of the full domestic amount — payroll will confirm.

liam-eng-manager: Ben — if this affects on-call or sprint planning, let me know. Also update your Slack profile with 'Homebase: SF / Vancouver (2d/wk)'.

ben-engineering: Filled the intake form just now. Thanks everyone. Any docs I should read on tax nexus risk?

alex-peopleops: Good call — see internal doc: https://redwood.company/docs/cross-border-work (internal) — TL;DR: recurring work in another country >60 days/year can create nexus; payroll will run a sim and advise. We'll loop in legal if needed.

samira-payroll: Got the intake. We'll run payroll sim and respond by EOD Tue. If payroll needs CAD pay we'll flag and propose options (CAD payroll vs FX adjustments).

ben-engineering: Awesome — appreciate the fast turnaround :thumbsup:

alex-peopleops: Looping @legal if payroll flags. For now we'll treat as recurring remote pattern, not relocation.

liam-eng-manager: Thanks team.
